question: What is the ratio of male per 100 females in Nepal in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**84.55.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• In 2020, male to female ratio for Nepal was **84.55 males per 100 females. **
 
• The Population of Nepal is 2.9 crores**.**
 
• The M**ale population is 1.36 crores **and the **Female population is 1.59 crores.**
 
• In the 1950s Nepal male to female sex ratio is** 98.2** that means out of 100 females in Nepal there are 98.2 males.
 
• In Nepal male to female **sex ratio is declining.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The** Population density** of Nepal is** 203person per square kilometer.**
